Blue Mountain Beach

.3 miles, roughly 600 steps, to Gulfview Heights Beach Access

Large private pool with spillover spa!

Hangout space: mini kitchenette, TV, Xbox, games, and foosball table!

Large, rooftop dining area!

7 bedroom, 7.5 baths

Three separate, indoor living areas

Gas fireplace

Golf cart!

2 natural gas grills

6 bikes!

5-star restaurants

Fun and yummy eateries

Our 30A Sandcastle by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Big, bright, and built for a crowd, this gorgeous Blue Mountain Beach home brings four floors of well-planned space, a private pool with a spillover spa(!), and a rooftop setup that’s hard to leave. It’s close to the beach and some of 30A’s favorite restaurants and fun, easygoing shops: Explore them all on a complimentary bike! Seven bedrooms and 7.5 baths give everyone room to settle in. The layout keeps things flowing, with three separate indoor living areas so the group can spread out without losing the togetherness part. The first floor is a hit with the kids (and anyone who likes a little friendly competition). There’s a hangout space with a mini kitchenette, TV, Xbox, games, and a foosball table. Step outside and you’re right at the pool, lounge area, and outdoor kitchen! Two bedrooms sit on this level, including a bunk room that sleeps ten, each bed gets its own TV, plus a nearby guest room. On the second floor, a chef’s kitchen anchors the space, with plenty of room to cook and a dining table that seats twenty without squeezing.

The living room feels grand but still cozy, with a gas fireplace and seating for everyone. Two primary bedrooms are also on this level. The third floor adds another living area, two more primary suites, and a guest room with a queen bed and two bunks, ideal for mixed groups or families traveling together. Then there’s the rooftop. An expansive space, you’ll love the covered outdoor kitchen, dining area, and lounge seating set the scene for long evenings, ocean air, and wide views. Outside, two natural gas grills handle dinner, and the private pool handles everything else. Six bikes and a golf cart make getting around simple. Ride one of the complimentary bikes over to nearby restaurants, ice cream spots, and local favorites: a definite trip highlight. Blue Mountain Beach sits between Gulf Place and Grayton Beach, known for its relaxed, family-friendly feel without giving up great food, shops, and things to do. Oversee 30A is local and close by, available daily with a 24/7 line for anything that comes up. BEACH ACCESS: Gulfview Heights Beach Access is the closest—about 600 steps (roughly 1,500 feet) from the house. It includes parking, restrooms, outdoor showers, covered picnic tables, and lifeguards during peak season. From the house, head right on 30A, turn right at Gulfview Heights Street by Goatfeathers, and follow it to the end. Overview: - 600 steps to Gulfview Heights Beach Access - 7 bedroom, 7.5 baths - 5,622 sq ft - Golf Cart - 6 Bikes - Private pool w/ spillover spa (pool can be heated seasonally for an additional $55.00 per day, contact Oversee for details) - Private backyard - Outdoor covered kitchen with ice machine, grill, refrigerator - Rooftop Sun Deck grill with covered and uncovered seating - Elevator with access to each floor - 1st Floor entertainment area with games, foosball, lounge and mini kitchenette - Bunk room that sleeps 10 all with their own tv - Fireplace - Balconies with outdoor seating - Dining table that can seat 20 - Fully stocked chef's kitchen with 2 dishwashers, ice maker, 6 burner gas stove Overnight: FIRST FLOOR - Guest Room: queen bed, ensuite Bath - Bunkroom: six bunks, each with own TV, ensuite bath SECOND FLOOR - Primary Bedroom: king bed, ensuite bath - Primary Bedroom: king bed, ensuite bath THIRD FLOOR - Primary Bedroom: king bed, ensuite bath - Guest Room: queen bed, four twin bunks, ensuite bath - Primary Bedroom: king bed, ensuite bath Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
